fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-04-16 states that two persons allegedly entered Oviya Fancy Store near Selvapuram Puram Main Street and took cash of about Rs. 5,000 after threatening the staff, on 2026-04-16 at roughly 19:55. The complaint was lodged by Kishore Selvam (9000000323). The complainant is associated with the business Oviya Fancy Store. A scooter bearing the number TN-01-YY-1046 was seen leaving the area. A further person, Siva Muthu, an intermediary, using the number 9000000256, is stated to be associated with the incident. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Yuvaraj Natarajan, using the number 9000000298. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects allegedly entered near closing time and threatened the staff. A scooter was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: shop robbery, cash, CCTV, associate, scooter, main street, evening, mobile number
